intro: Kuwait has about 5 million people, but only around a third are Kuwaiti citizens.

chapters.title: People
text: Most residents come from India, Egypt, Bangladesh, the Philippines and elsewhere. Most citizens are Sunni Muslim, with a large Shia minority. Arabic is the official language.

chapters.title: Stateless people
text: Tens of thousands of people known as Bidoon have no citizenship, a long-running issue.

keyTerms.meaning: Stateless residents of Kuwait, from the Arabic for 'without'.
